The Fed aims for 2% inflation over the longer run as measured by the annual change in headline PCE, a broader gauge of consumer spending prices than CPI. Policymakers also study core PCE, which excludes food and energy, to judge the direction of underlying price pressure. Core PCE rose from 3.0% in December 2025 to 3.3% in June 2026, keeping the Fed cautious despite July’s softer CPI reading. [...] 1.
